overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: What this runtime is doing right now. Refreshes every 5 seconds while open.
overview.sessionsSubtitle: One actor per (agent, session key). Busy means a turn is running.
overview.sessionsEmpty: No live sessions. A session starts on its agent's first message.
overview.agentsSubtitle: Configured at boot; Studio-applied agents appear under Agents.
overview.agentsEmpty: No agents in the config. Create one from Agents.
overview.channelsEmpty: No channels. Add one from Channels; it binds at the next start.
overview.instancesSubtitle: Every process currently heartbeating on this runtime store. An epoch that differs means two instances run different configs.
overview.instancesEmpty: No live instances reported. This runtime may predate the instance registry.
overview.onboarding: No agents yet — get started by configuring a model, creating an agent, and testing it in Playground.
